factor_specs.proxy: DPL_KR_v1 (Transformer-lite encoder + Score Head + 4-stage constraint projection + Net-Sharpe utility loss)
factor_specs.lag_rule: PIT C1~C15 strict, features at sig_date_t only (no future leak)
factor_specs.neutralization: cross-section Z-score per sig_date per feature (Z_Score_Aligned C13)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: 두 단계 paradigm (μ̂ estimate → MVO optimization)의 두 가지 misalignment 해결: (a) error maximization (Michaud 1989) 즉 μ̂ noise가 weight에서 증폭 (b) objective mismatch (Elmachtoub-Grigas 2017) 즉 prediction MSE와 portfolio Sharpe loss 일치 안 함. DPL은 features → weights 직접 학습으로 두 misalignment 동시 해결. KR 첫 적용 — STR_1715 (SR 1.95 baseline) substitution 또는 4th orthogonal source 자격 검증.

metric_definitions.rank_ic: Spearman corr(alpha_score_t, r_t+1) cross-sectional per sig_date, averaged across all test sig_dates post-training
metric_definitions.icir: rolling 60m IC mean / IC std, computed from test_window predictions
metric_definitions.monotonicity: decile portfolio returns monotonicity coefficient (Patton-Timmermann 2010 style)

metric_definitions.harvey_t_stat: Newey-West t-stat with lag=12, computed against 5 spec panel (CAPM/FF3/FF5/Carhart4/FF6), target ≥ 3.0 (Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 multiple testing)

diagnostics_specification.DSR_method: Bailey-Lopez de Prado strict (n_trials=100 via hyperparam grid expansion, B=10000 bootstrap)

ic_provenance.method: DPL alpha_score = ScoreHead(Transformer(FeatureEmbed(X_t)))_normalized cross-sectional Z. IC = cor(alpha_score, r_t+1) Spearman.

mechanism_description: Direct Portfolio Learning (DPL) paradigm — features → portfolio weights를 end-to-end neural network가 직접 학습. KR equity universe 첫 적용. 입력: 644 PIT-clean features × 124 sig_dates (2016-01 ~ 2026-04, post macro-prefix drop). Encoder: Transformer-lite (heads=2, dim=64, n_layers=2). Score head: Linear → R^N. Constraint projection 4-stage: ReLU long-only → Gumbel softmax τ-anneal top-K=20 → bounds clip [0, 0.20] → L1 normalize Σw=1. Loss: -E[r_p,t+1] + γ_cost·0.0015·|Δw| - λ_cvar·CVaR_5%(r_p). Walk-forward 5 windows shift-12m overlapping. Gates: G0 PIT C1~C15 strict + G1 SR≥1.0 + G2 cor<0.5 substitution / <0.3 4th-source + G3 Harvey-t≥3.0 5 specs + G4 DSR Bailey-LdP Z≥0 + G5 cost-net Pareto + G6 AX-008 ≥ 2/3. 학술 토대: Elmachtoub-Grigas 2017 SPO+, Uysal-Li-Mulvey 2021 E2E, Wei-Dai-Lin 2023 E2EAI, Kim et al. 2025 DSL, Wang-Hasuike 2026 SPO Portfolio.
harvey_t_count_pending_forge: Forge cycle will compute t-stats from realized test returns vs 5 spec panel using Newey-West HAC variance estimator (lag=12).
alpha_rank_corr_provenance: post-Forge cycle: DPL alpha_scores vs STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2 alpha_scores Pearson + Spearman per sig_date, averaged over test windows. Production STR_1715 alpha at 05_Production/2.Factor_Model/2-1.STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2/02_holdings_universe/alpha_scores_str1715_268m.parquet

Target outcomes: (a) cor<0.5 substitution sleeve candidate (probability ~0.30-0.40), (b) cor<0.3 4th orthogonal source candidate (probability ~0.15-0.25). SR 2.0+ admit candidate (probability ~0.20-0.30) given Path A/B/C 3-cycle fail (L-323/325/326) — Path D is architectural paradigm shift.
